summary: The filing is a Form 6-K furnishing a preliminary short-form base shelf prospectus filed on SEDAR+ in Canada. Collective Mining Ltd. registers up to $500M in common shares, debt securities, subscription receipts, warrants, and units for potential future offerings over 25 months. This is a routine shelf registration to provide financing flexibility, not a specific special situation event. No terms, prices, or imminent transactions are disclosed. As a shelf prospectus, it is a preparatory filing and does not constitute an active deal, thus it falls outside special-situations categories.
